title.narrative: Accelerating Innovative Start-ups for Energy Efficiency

description.narrative: Viet Nam is one of the most energy-intensive countries in East Asia. To support the Viet Nam - National Energy Efficiency Program (VNEEP3) which was set up by the government of Viet Nam to address this challenge, the European Union Delegation to Vietnam (EUD) and GGGI kicked off the “Accelerating Innovative Start-ups for Energy Efficiency” (AIS4EE) program in 2022. The project focuses on accelerating innovation and market development of the energy efficiency (EE) sector, with the following key components: · Increasing investments in innovative business solutions to start-ups in EE for industry, transportation, and green building through the implementation of an acceleration program. · Improving innovative ecosystem for start-ups in energy efficiency in the long term through (i) training of trainers and building a network of start-up ecosystem stakeholders in energy efficiency; (ii) capacity building for potential EE start-up founders and investors and (iii) raising awareness for the public at large.
